Lets debate about the ages of the characters.

We all know the age of Rand, Perrin, and Mat and some other main characters, so if anyone wants to give their opinions of the ages of some of the characters, say Thom, Moriaine, Siuan, and etc.{{Forumheader|The Inn}}
